name: Funi-kun no Obenkyou 2 ~Hoshuu Jugyou~
original_name: フニ君のお勉強２　～補習授業～
source:
The next day after the bathroom incident Funi's mother calls out main character to their house. The family is surprisingly friendly at first, but soon unload full weight of guilt on the protagonist. What will he do now?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
浴室事件的第二天，伏尼的母亲把主人公叫到家里。起初，这家人出人意料地友善，但很快便把全部罪恶感压到主人公身上。他现在会怎么做？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
